title: BLE replay
attack_vector: Adversary in the Middle or BLE replay attack capturing pairing tokens or unlock commands to spoof legitimate user.

title: cloud account takeover
attack_vector: Cloud account takeover exploiting valid credentials or phishing to gain administrative control and issue unauthorized commands.

title: malicious OTA firmware
attack_vector: Malicious OTA firmware delivery replacing authentic device firmware via unauthenticated or unverified update mechanism.

title: eavesdropping/MitM
attack_vector: Eavesdropping and adversary-in-the-middle sniffing communication traffic on unencrypted channels to disclose sensitive information.

title: DoS on cloud
attack_vector: Denial of Service via resource exhaustion flooding cloud or lock communication channels to prevent normal lock operations.

title: key extraction via side-channel
attack_vector: Cryptographic key extraction via physical or electromagnetic side-channel analysis.
